description: TEMPLATE — `cmd` here is a non-functional placeholder (cmd MUST be an ABSOLUTE path; the runner rejects a relative/bare command, so this file is not runnable as-is). `review install-hook tg` always overwrites `cmd` with the absolute path of THIS repo's pre_send_photo.py (the file next to this descriptor), resolved from whatever tg-cli checkout it finds (REVIEW_TG_CLI_SOURCE env var, else ~/.files/repos/tg-cli, else ~/xp/tg-cli). It never copies the script — `git pull` in that checkout is the whole resync step, so hand-editing the installed copy under ~/.agents/hooks/tg/ (there is none anymore) is never needed again. Runs `review visual <png> --json --strict` on the outgoing photo and blocks (exit 10) an unstyled/broken/blank render. Vision is slow, so timeout_ms is 60s and on_error is open: a slow or unavailable vision call NEVER blocks a send unless the verdict is an explicit rollback. Exception (tg-cli#163): a rollback caused SOLELY by the selection-highlight module veto is downgraded to a WARN (exit 0, send proceeds) — that caption-text-triggered CV check can't tell a HyperCanvas canvas selection from a non-canvas one, see pre_send_photo.py for the full rationale.
